senses.gloss: ch. sameto cut, cut off.—Part. גָּאִיז, גָּיֵיז.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 67b:6">Gitt. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>זימנין דג׳ ליה לדיבוריה</he> sometimes one cuts his speech short (does not finish his sentence).—

<cite ref="Nedarim 68a:3">Ned. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>בעל מֵיגַז גָּיֵיז</he> does the husband (betrothed) cut the vow apart, i.e. annul half the vow of his betrothed, leaving it to her father to annul the other half?, opp. <he>מיקלש קליש</he> he weakens the stringency of the entire vow.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 51:10">Targ. Is. LI, 10</cite>.—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:8:1">Koh. R. to VII, 8</cite> <he>גייז וכ׳</he> passed the street riding on horse-back (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 974">Yalk. ib. 974</cite> <cite ref="P00061"><he>עבר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 37">Lev. R. s. 37</cite> [read:] <he>מן דגייזין בחד נהר</he> when they were crossing a river.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>מְגִיזָה יתיה וכ׳</he> carried it across the river; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8">Koh. R. to V, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 972:1">Yalk. ib. 972</cite> <cite ref="M00154"><he>מְגִיזָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:4">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> <he>ומגזתיה</he> (corr. <he>ומְגִיזְתֵּיה</he>). Koh. R. l. c. <he>אֲגִיזְתֵּיה</he> she carried it over; Lev. R. l. c. <he>אגיזתא</he> (corr. acc.).
